sdk_dir.ask: Folder holding Thermo.Chromeleon.Sdk.dll (the Chromeleon bin folder)

data_vault.ask: Data vault folder the agent creates sequences in (chrom:// URL as the Chromeleon console shows it)
data_vault.help: The folder must also hold (or be able to see) the instrument and processing methods the agent may use.

instrument.ask: Instrument the sequences run on (chrom:// URL)

username.ask: Chromeleon user the agent logs on as (Enter to use the interactive logon)
username.help: A dedicated user with rights to the data vault folder and to control the instrument; no right to edit or delete methods or data.

processing_method.ask: Processing method used when a sample names none
